reason: Added an editorial global stylesheet (src/styles.css, imported from src/main.tsx, with src/vite-env.d.ts for the CSS import types) following the approved plan: paper-and-ink palette with a deep-red accent, serif masthead and task titles, uppercase letter-spaced kicker labels and metadata, a single 48rem reading column, rule-separated tasks, accent-filled starred button, 2px accent focus rings, italic empty state and reduced-motion handling. Markup changes are className additions only in App.tsx and TaskList.tsx; no text, roles, aria-* attributes, data-testid values or element order changed, and the existing tests are untouched. Computed-style Playwright tests for AC1-AC12 and the reduced-motion NFR are in e2e/styling.spec.ts with a pure WCAG contrast helper in e2e/support/contrast.ts. Lint, typecheck, unit tests (44) and build pass locally; the browser e2e tests could not launch in the sandbox and are left to the coordinator's checks. One small refinement to the plan: below 480px the controls bar switches to a two-column grid so each label stays beside its control at 320px (the flex row from the plan still applies at 481px and up).
